temporal_notes: Archival sample collected in 2006 from Gounougou, previously described in Wondji et al. 2011, genotyped in this study for temporal analysis.
coord_source_text: Adult Mosquitoes were collected from the locality of Gounougou (9° 03′ 00″N, 13°43′ 59″ E) in northern Cameroon.
source_text: In addition An. funestus mosquitoes collected in 2006 in the same location, described previously in [10], were also used during this study for TaqMan genotyping of some resistance markers.

temporal_notes: Collection carried out between December 2011 and January 2012 at the beginning of the dry season.
coord_source_text: Adult Mosquitoes were collected from the locality of Gounougou (9° 03′ 00″N, 13°43′ 59″ E) in northern Cameroon.
source_text: A total of 402 F0 female mosquitoes collected resting indoor in 2012 were morphologically identified as belonging to An. funestus group. PCR species identification revealed that all mosquitoes were An. funestus s.s. apart from two individuals that were confirmed to be An. leesoni.

temporal_notes: Collection performed in January 2015 to monitor resistance dynamics.
coord_source_text: Adult Mosquitoes were collected from the locality of Gounougou (9° 03′ 00″N, 13°43′ 59″ E) in northern Cameroon.
source_text: For 2015, 165 F1 egg batches were obtained.
